summary: Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing Q1 2026 financial results. The filing reports total revenues of $18.4 million, net income of $2.8 million ($0.05 per share), and cash of $27.6 million. It also notes continued share issuance under a June 2025 purchase agreement with B. Riley Principal Capital II LLC (260,628 shares at ~$1.27 avg). This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation event disclosed.
